alerts.description:
* WHAT...For the Frost Advisory, temperatures as low as 33 will
result in frost formation. For the Freeze Warning, sub-freezing
temperatures as low as 30 expected.

* WHERE...Portions of central, east central, north central,
northeast, southeast, and west central Georgia.

* WHEN...For the Frost Advisory, until 9 AM EST this morning. For the
Freeze Warning, from 1 AM to 9 AM EST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other
sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor
plumbing. Frost could harm sensitive outdoor vegetation. Sensitive
outdoor plants may be killed if left uncovered.
alerts.headline: Freeze Warning issued November 14 at 2:44AM EST until November 15 at 9:00AM EST by NWS Peachtree City GA
alerts.instruction:
Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.

To prevent water pipes from freezing; wrap or drain or allow them to
drip slowly.
